The project will develop and implement two international online Micro Masters, which will be provided by a virtual campus of four HEIs – Istanbul University (Turkey), Institute of Communication Studies (Macedonia), DOBA Faculty of Applied Business and Social Studies (Slovenia), and the Vytautas Magnus University (Lithuania). The 6-month specializations will provide deep learning in the specific career fields of (1) Entrepreneurship Ecosystem and Innovation Strategy, and (2) Future Communication
